decisions.reason: The account-access instruction changes where the work must be performed but does not change the duplicate page's pricing-section removal requirement.
The workspace correction does not change the monthly marker, its typography, or its coverage.
The instruction to use the correct account does not alter the required duplicate artifact or its duplication timing; workspace targeting remains independently represented by the source Requirement.
The account-access change does not alter the required panel count, panel removal, or pricing-section layout rule.
The workspace instruction does not change which Q&A box must be absent.
The correct-account instruction does not change the secondary control's label or required coverage.
The workspace correction does not change the secondary control's placement relative to the primary button.
The account-access instruction does not change the secondary control's wrapper or visual styling requirements.
The instruction identifies the workspace in which work must occur but does not change the expected top-block layout.
The workspace correction does not change the requirement that the bonus section be removed.
The correct-account instruction does not change the expected alignment of the instructor section.
The workspace correction does not change the required top-section media or its playback behavior.
